lines.en: I hop across the grass.

lines.zh: 我在草地上蹦着走，尾巴一甩一甩。
lines.en: I hop along the grass, tail swinging.

lines.zh: 这是我孵出来以后第一次走远。
lines.en: This is my first time going far since hatching.

lines.zh: 我从数码蛋里出来，很轻。
lines.en: Fresh from a digitama, I am light.
I don't dare go too far.
I shuffle along on short legs.
This is the forest's edge.
I hop onto a stone.
The grass is taller than I am.
I tripped and clambered up.

lines.zh: 我回头看了看蛋壳的位置。
lines.en: I look back at where the shell was.
I slowly walk back to the anchor.
I crouch beside the anchor.
My tail circles around me.
Small body, but the teeth came first.

lines.zh: 我站起来，不到你的膝盖。
lines.en: I stand no taller than your knee.
The wind pushes me back a little.
I open my mouth and hiccup.
The air here is fresh.
I stare at my own claws.
Can I still get stronger?

lines.zh: 我坐下来，尾巴垫在身下。
lines.en: I sit down and tuck my tail beneath me.
I'll lie here a little longer.
I'm a little tired.
I just came out of a Digitama.
My breathing is barely audible.
You bent down to look at me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，像看一棵树。
lines.en: I look up at you as if at a tree.
So small, will you take me with you?
I don't know yet.
I'm not scared of your hand.
Your hand is bigger than I am.
I retreat behind the anchor.
This is my spot.
Fresh from the egg, all I do is bubble.
Let me sniff you.

lines.zh: 我绕你一圈，只到你鞋跟高。
lines.en: I circle you once, no taller than your heel.

lines.zh: 你手指上的味道，我记下了。
lines.en: The smell on your fingers — I have memorized it.
Will you take me with you?
I haven't been tamed.

lines.zh: 我看见别的数码兽都有人。
lines.en: I've seen other Digimon with someone.
I want that too.
I got hit.
I rolled into the grass.
It hurts.
My body is too small.
I push myself up on short forelegs.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身上，泡泡都散了。
lines.en: I shake myself; the bubbles scatter.
I haven't come apart yet.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在小小的身体里。
lines.en: I keep this blow in my tiny body.
I have to get stronger.
I still have a lot of eating to do.
Is that In-Training food?

lines.zh: 我尾巴一甩一甩，闻得出来。
lines.en: My tail flicks as I sniff it out.
Put it down. Lower it.
This smells better than grass.

lines.zh: 肚子叫了，我往你脚边蹦。
lines.en: My belly growls and I hop toward your feet.
I hopped to your feet.
Don't walk away.
I eat fast. The bowl's already empty.

lines.zh: 我嘴里嚼着，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I chew and keep my eyes on you.
Is there more?

lines.zh: 嘴角还挂着上一口的渣。
lines.en: Crumbs from the last bite still cling to my mouth.
I look up at your hand.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖碰了我，我滚了半圈。
lines.en: Your boot tip touches me and I roll half a turn.
I rolled once.
I'm small. One touch moves me.
Don't step on me.
I dodged from your feet.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我又站好。
lines.en: We bumped, and I steadied again.

lines.zh: 我滚了一圈，撞在你脚边。
lines.en: I roll once and bump into your feet.
A little hollow remains in the ground.
You're so much heavier.
I backed toward the anchor.

lines.zh: 我连自己的尾巴都追不上。
lines.en: I cannot even catch my own tail.

lines.zh: 我还不会吐完整的泡泡。
lines.en: I cannot even blow a whole bubble yet.
I haven't even evolved yet.

lines.zh: 我孵出来才几天，别问我。
lines.en: I hatched only days ago — do not ask me.
I want to grow sturdier.

lines.zh: 幼年期Ⅰ的我，说不了几句。
lines.en: Baby I stage. Not many words yet.
I still need to eat.

lines.zh: 我在锚点边上，等你回来。
lines.en: I wait by the anchor for you to return.
Just stay with me a while.
This is enough for now.
I can't lift it.

lines.zh: 这东西立起来比我还高。
lines.en: This thing stands taller than I am.

lines.zh: 我用脑袋顶，它纹丝不动。
lines.en: I push with my head; it does not budge.
It rolled away.
Did this fall off you?
I bite it and drag it along.
It's harder than the food.
This thing is harder than my teeth.

lines.zh: 幼年期的嘴，什么都想咬。
lines.en: A baby-stage mouth wants to bite everything.
Too heavy; I put it back.
Something moves beyond the grass blades.
Not grass.

lines.zh: 耳朵动了一下，我听见了。
lines.en: My ear twitches — I heard it.

lines.zh: 尾巴竖起来，只到我耳朵高。
lines.en: My tail stands up, reaching only my ears.
I've never fought before.
But I can't back down.
I have to try.
Crouched low, saving up a bubble.

lines.zh: 它伸过来的影子就比我大。
lines.en: Even its shadow is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我迈出一步，还是走了过去。
lines.en: I take one step — and still go forward.
I opened my mouth, ready.
I made a sound to scare it.
I'm running after it.
My short legs can't keep up.
I can't see it in the grass.
I crouch and listen.
It's on the other side.

lines.zh: 我绕过树干，草比我还高。
lines.en: I round the trunk, the grass taller than me.

lines.zh: 草根绊了我，我趴进泥里。
lines.en: A grass root trips me and I flop into the mud.

lines.zh: 我从泥里爬起来，腿还在抖。
lines.en: I get up from the mud, legs still trembling.
It looked back.
I barked at it.
My legs shake, but I do not retreat.
My tail twitched.

lines.zh: 幼年期的我，只会往前扑。
lines.en: A baby Digimon can only lunge.
My teeth have only just come in.
That wasn't enough.
I lashed with my tail.
I nearly bit it.
It hit back.
One shake and I roll into the bushes.

lines.zh: 我又冲上去，撞在它腿上。
lines.en: I charge again and bounce off its leg.

lines.zh: 这次咬住了，就挂在上面。
lines.en: This time I latch on and hang there.
I let go quickly.
I bite a second time; my teeth still slip.
That one missed.
The shell cracked open.
I crawled out.
My fuzz is still wet.
The anchor is right there.
The grass is so big.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，只吐出一个泡。
lines.en: I open my mouth and only a bubble comes out.

lines.zh: 这声音连我自己都吓到。
lines.en: My own voice startled me.
I take two steps forward.
This is my starting point.
I'll grow from here.
I look at my tail.
It's still very short.

lines.zh: 火烫到尾巴，我跳起来了。
lines.en: Fire touched my tail and I jumped.

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下来，翻了个身。
lines.en: I fell off the stone and rolled over.
The water went over my head.

lines.zh: 气浪把我翻了个跟头，落在草里。
lines.en: The blast flips me head over heels into the grass.

lines.zh: 箭头擦过绒毛，带走一撮。
lines.en: The arrow grazes my fluff and carries a tuft away.
The light was too bright to see.
I'm hungry. My stomach won't stop growling.

lines.zh: 雷声把我吓得躲在草里。
lines.en: The thunder scared me into the grass.

lines.zh: 我这么小，连泡都吐不稳。
lines.en: Tiny as I am, my bubble wavers.
